novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new phenomenon and mechanistic framing—“iterating distillation over many generations ... produces predictable population dynamics” including amplification, extinction, and directional drift—rather than merely introducing a new measurement. Searches using “subliminal learning recursive generations,” “subliminal learning model-on-model training,” “steering vector distillation recursive,” and “recursive synthetic data hidden traits” found *Subliminal Learning Is Steering Vector Distillation* (2026) and *Subliminal Learning is a LoRA Artifact* (2026), which analyze single-step transfer, alongside recursive model-collapse work such as *Rate of Model Collapse in Recursive Training* (AISTATS 2024); none directly studies hidden-trait dynamics across successive subliminal-learning generations. The step from those works to this claim is a new core relationship—not just a direct object transfer—because it hypothesizes gain-dependent trait population dynamics and cross-generation steering-direction drift, though it remains within the established recursive-training framework rather than introducing a new paradigm, warranting a high-but-not-paradigm score.
